body:
As Said Before Vaporization is Key
Vaporizing is the key, I think.  I did a quickie vaporize with a test tube and an alcohol lamp.  Vapor is much more tolerable than the smoke, but it has an intensely acrid, acidic taste to it.  The good news is it leaves my mouth quickly.
This came after smoking some flowers.  I smoked maybe 6-7 flowers and didn't feel anything except a slight head buzz and a pressure on my forehead.  After I vaped, I noticed within 5-10 minutes that I was very sedated, like I had had a couple beers.  I was aware that turning my head seemed like a complicated process; I started to ponder all the muscles that were needed for this action.  Slightly reminiscent of alcohol, less of MJ.  Sexual desire increased slightly.  Overall feeling was relaxed, but it was such a slight feeling that trying to identify it in concrete terms felt confusing at the time.  Very slight disorientation, felt the need to lie down and veg out in front of tv.
I'm definitely going to try vaping alone next time
